name: 异世界访客
description: 每个新玩家注册后获得的角色卡，是卡迪安生活的入口，背单词从这里开始。战斗中只能使用通用技能卡。
descriptionEn: The character card every new player receives on registration: the gateway to life in Cardian, where word learning begins. In battle only common skill cards can be used.

name: 学者
description: 唯一可以在熔炉中合成技能卡的职业。功能性角色，不参与战斗。
descriptionEn: The only class that can synthesize skill cards at the forge. A functional character that does not fight.

name: 召唤师
description: 除通用技能卡外，还可以使用召唤技能卡，召唤有独立血量的召唤物并肩作战。
descriptionEn: Besides common skill cards, can use summon skill cards to call forth summons with their own HP.

name: 火魔法师
description: 火系魔法师，专属技能卡附带灼烧效果。
descriptionEn: Fire mage; exclusive skill cards apply burn.

name: 水魔法师
description: 水系魔法师，专属技能卡偏治疗与护盾。
descriptionEn: Water mage; exclusive skill cards focus on healing and shields.

name: 雷魔法师
description: 雷系魔法师，专属技能卡偏先手与连锁伤害。
descriptionEn: Thunder mage; exclusive skill cards favor initiative and chain damage.

name: 冰魔法师
description: 冰系魔法师，专属技能卡附带冻结效果。
descriptionEn: Ice mage; exclusive skill cards apply freeze.

name: 土魔法师
description: 土系魔法师，专属技能卡偏护盾与嘲讽。
descriptionEn: Earth mage; exclusive skill cards focus on shields and taunt.
